explanations.a: This is the moment of inertia for a solid disc, but it does not account for the experimental method using identical masses.
explanations.b: This is the correct formula for the moment of inertia of the disc, derived from equation (12) in the theory, using periods T0, T1, T2 and distances d1, d2.
explanations.c: This is an incorrect combination of moments of inertia.
explanations.d: This is a rearrangement of the period formula, not related to determining I0.
